fields.description:
## Context

Sibling-emitted candidate fixture specs assert a criterion should fire or stay silent for a real
plan — from history, not current code. One run cannot settle it — byte-identical material flipped verdict in
208 of 551 pairs, so shipped specs use `epochs: 3`/`gate: at_least(2)`.

## Approach

**Rehydrate, then run.** The selector manifest lists candidates per criterion, each carrying
`direction` (fire/no_fire) and a `review_event_uuid` — the join key to the review sidecar (`fixture_selection.py` schema, shared with the emitter prerequisite). A candidate's emitter `input` is a model-free
provenance descriptor, NOT plan text, so the finder never runs on it. It loads the
sidecar corpus the selector used (`corpus.build_corpus`, persisting verified rows of at-review material keyed by
`review_event_uuid`; `corpus.py:_build_sidecar_row`), and REHYDRATES each case's finder input from the matched row:
`description` as plan text. Container criteria (G3/G4/decomp-shape) are SCOPED OUT before any finder call (see Non-goals): the corpus persists `children` as bare ticket-id strings only. A candidate resolving to no verified row is withheld to drift as
unrecoverable material (no finder call). It runs the criterion's current Pass-1 finder via `eval_solver.run_case(...)` (`eval_solver.py:322`)
with `case["input"]` the rehydrated material (not `calibrate_criterion`). Each case runs three times; `_fired(verdict)` (a finding present) is the observed verdict; a case matching its
`expect` (`finding`/`pass`) in ≥2 of 3 runs REPRODUCES (current code still agrees with history).

**Disposition.** A reproducing case is kept; a non-reproducing one is withheld to a drift report at
`docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/fixtures/drift-report.md` (criterion, case id, predicted vs
observed, originating review `(ticket_id, review_event_uuid)`). To write a spec the runner reuses
the emitter's strict-only skeleton (`prompt`, `model`, `epochs`, `gate`, `coverage_threshold`,
`scorers`) UNCHANGED, and rebuilds `dataset` + `gold_set` (1:1) from only the reproducing cases,
each case's `input` the runnable rehydrated material. The spec is written to
`.rebar/evals/<prompt-id>.eval.yaml` via a temp file + atomic `os.replace` only when the filtered
dataset is balanced (both sides non-empty), `gold_set` non-empty, and
`validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True)` returns zero errors; else withheld. The runner
returns an in-memory summary (admitted/withheld ids, drift, spend); only the drift report and admitted specs are written.

**No-shadowing guard.** A user `.rebar/evals/<id>.eval.yaml` WINS over a packaged built-in at load, so the runner SKIPS any criterion packaged in `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/`.

**Budget enforcement.** Before each criterion the run pre-flights
`ledger.reserve(estimate_usd, cap_usd=250.0, reserve_usd=0.0)` against this epic's ledger
`docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/fixtures/ledger.jsonl` (reserve_usd=0 ⇒ ceiling $250), then `finalize()`s priced ACTUAL usage. After each `finalize` the run re-reads cumulative spend and
halts FATALLY before the next criterion if it meets/exceeds `cap_usd`, so $250 bounds finalized spend. The estimate tier follows `exec` routing
(`criteria.effective_routing`, ADR 0033): AGENT→`criteria-eval-agent`, else `criteria-eval-cheap`;
`exec: DET` out of scope. Model parity pinned to production Pass-1 (ADR 0109).

**Failure disposition.** Per criterion the two writes are STRICTLY ORDERED — atomic spec
`os.replace` FIRST, ledger `finalize()` SECOND — with the ledger the sole resume oracle: a criterion
is done iff its stable `run_id = f"admission-{prompt_id}"` is in the ledger. Crash before the ledger row ⇒ resume re-derives, overwriting the orphan spec; crash after ⇒ the spec exists. A transient model/transport error is
RETRYABLE (3×, exp backoff 1s/2s/4s); on exhaustion the criterion is left incomplete (no ledger
row; run continues). Both a `reserve` `BudgetExceeded` and the post-`finalize` cap breach are
FATAL, stopping with finalized criteria admitted; `reconcile` recharges no recorded `run_id`.

## Scope

The admission runner, its rehydration/disposition logic, the drift-report writer, and the
`.rebar/evals/` specs.

## Non-goals

Container criteria (G3/G4/decomp-shape) are OUT of the runner: the corpus persists children as bare ids (no per-child title/description), so a rehydrated container case scores the finder over an impoverished roster — UNFAITHFUL to the historical review (whose finder read full child state), and `material_fingerprint` (children hashed by id) cannot detect the loss. Each is withheld `container-material-unrecoverable` pending faithful per-child capture (follow-up ticket). Repairing drift (each entry becomes a ticket linked `discovered_from` the epic); editing
`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/`; scheduling re-runs (the self-healing loop owns it).

## Testing

Unit tests drive disposition with a scripted stub solver and stub sidecar index (no model); the
live run covers the real path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A must-fire case whose `review_event_uuid` resolves to a sidecar row runs the finder on that
      row's rehydrated `description`, not the descriptor; scripted (fire, fire, silent) it is admitted
      with that material as its `input` (`pytest`).
- [x] A must-fire case scripted (fire, silent, silent) is withheld with a drift entry
      (its originating review `(ticket_id, review_event_uuid)`); a case whose `review_event_uuid`
      matches no verified row is likewise withheld as unrecoverable material, no finder call
      (`pytest`).
- [x] With the ledger at the ceiling, the first `reserve` raises `BudgetExceeded` and a
      call-counting stub reports `0` model calls (`pytest`).
- [x] When a finalized criterion's ACTUAL spend reaches/passes `cap_usd`, the run halts before the
      next criterion (the breaching one stays admitted); `pytest` prices rows above the estimate.
- [x] Every written spec passes the real `validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True)` over each file
      (`pytest`).
- [x] A criterion matching a packaged built-in in `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/` is skipped while a
      same-id `.rebar/evals/` prior artifact is NOT; `pytest` asserts written and packaged basenames are
      disjoint and the seeded id was processed.
- [x] A criterion writes no `.eval.yaml` when its reproducing cases leave one side empty (drifting
      its cases) or when a case raises before all finish (no partial file) (`pytest`).
- [x] Resume is crash-consistent (`pytest`): a re-run recharges no finalized criterion (`reconcile`
      returns the existing row, zero new calls); a spec file with no ledger row (crash between
      writes) is re-derived to one ledger row.
- [x] On a transient model/transport error the finder is retried 3×, then the criterion is left
      incomplete (no `.eval.yaml`, no ledger row) and the run continues (`pytest`, a stub raising
      transient errors).
- [x] [non-codebase] A live admission run has completed over the full candidate set with the Pass-1
      model pinned to its production class, and this epic's ledger records total spend >0 and ≤250.0
      with a per-pass model id on every row.
      provenance: environment=dev workstation, production Bedrock chain (bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8); principal=RebarBotNava <joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com>; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — production Pass-1 at parity; ledger $11.65, 15 admitted rows (G3/G4 withheld container-material-unrecoverable).
- [x] [non-codebase] Each drift-report entry has a ticket linked `discovered_from` the parent epic.
      provenance: environment=production rebar tickets store; principal=RebarBotNava <joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com>; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 71 tickets linked discovered_from the epic.

## Definition of Done

`make lint`/`make typecheck`/`make test` pass; live run completed; drift report and admitted specs
committed; ledger spend ≤ $250.
